ResearchProjectDef.label: Agrihand
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a small mechanoid designed to sow and harvest crops.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Airwire headset
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a head-mounted comms computer that slightly enhances a mechanitor's control bandwidth, allowing them to control more mechs.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Band node
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a signal amplifying structure that grants an additional bandwidth to a mechanitor, allowing them to control more mechs.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Constructoid
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a small mechanoid designed to construct buildings and repair structures.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Control pack
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a backpack containing mech control computers, allowing its mechanitor to control one additional group.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Lifter
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a small mechanoid designed to lift and haul objects.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Militor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a small mechanoid equipped with a mini-shotgun, designed for combat and defense.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Control sublink
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a neural implant that allows a mechanitor to control another group and increase mech work speeds.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Array headset
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a head-mounted signal array computer that greatly enhances a mechanitor's control bandwidth, allowing them to control significantly more mechs.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Bandwidth pack
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a backpack containing bandwidth enhancement devices, allowing its mechanitor to control one additional group.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Cyclops
ResearchProjectDef.description: Produce a front-line combat mechanoid named for its large optical array. The cyclops specializes in counter-shield attacks. It takes a long time to lock onto a target, but once locked on, it fires a near endless barrage of shield-piercing beams.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Mech gestation processor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Produce an implant that can accelerate the speed at which a mechanitor can gestate mechanoids.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Mechcommander helmet
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a plasteel-weave combat helmet designed for battle mechanitors. It is embedded with computers and signal enhancers that moderately increase the wearer's maximum control bandwidth. This allows the mechanitor to control more mechs.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Pikeman
ResearchProjectDef.description: Produce a clunky multi-legged combat mechanoid specialized as a long-range weapons platform. While effective at distance, it is weak in close-range fights and in melee combat.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Scorcher
ResearchProjectDef.description: Produce a close-approach war mechanoid that specializes in incendiary attacks. Its flame burst attack has little reach, but once it closes on a group of defenders it can ignite and disrupt them with blasts of searing flame.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Tunneler
ResearchProjectDef.description: Produce a heavy mechanoid built for mining in treacherous locations. While intended for excavation, the tunneler's gigantic power claws and ultra-thick armor makes it a dangerous force in combat.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Centipedes
ResearchProjectDef.description: Produce heavy combat mechanoids that glide on dozens of tiny legs. Their thick carapace and firepower makes them very effective against bunched-up static defenders. They are somewhat vulnerable to mobile hit-and-run tactics.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Diabolus
ResearchProjectDef.description: Produce an ultra-heavy mechanoid with an ultra-powerful hellsphere cannon. Made for siegebreaking, its hellsphere cannon takes time to charge up a shot, but can melt concrete and vaporize bone. The diabolus dissipates the hellsphere cannon's waste power in a heat column mounted on its back, which can pulse to ignite flammable objects nearby.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Fabricor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Produce a small work mechanoid designed to craft all manner of manufactured objects.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Integrator headset
ResearchProjectDef.description: Produce an advanced head-mounted computer and signaling array that dramatically enhances a mechanitor's control bandwidth. This allows the wearer to control many more mechanoids at once.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Mech booster
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a remote energy and computation enhancement device. Any friendly mechanoids in its effect radius will move and work faster.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Paramedic
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a small mechanoid designed for non-violent emergency situation management and medical care. The paramedic can rescue the wounded, fight fires, treat the sick, and even perform surgery when a more-qualified human is not available. Its built-in jump launcher allows it to jump into, and out of, emergency situations, and its built-in firefoam popper can quickly extinguish fires.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Mechlord suit
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a power-assisted armor suit packed with mechanitor-assistance gear. The mechlord suit dramatically amplifies a mechanitor's bandwidth, but is somewhat less protective than dedicated heavy armor.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Repair probe
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a power-assisted armor suit packed with mechanitor-assistance gear. The mechlord suit dramatically amplifies a mechanitor's bandwidth, but is somewhat less protective than dedicated heavy armor.
